title: C-Dogs SDL
tagline: Top-down run-and-gun: missions, co-op and deathmatch for up to four players.
summary: C-Dogs SDL (Ronny Wester's C-Dogs, 1997; SDL port by Jeremy Chin, Lucas Martin-King and Cong Xu) is an overhead shooter: pick a campaign, kill the targets, rescue the prisoners, collect the items and get everyone to the exit, alone or with up to three friends on one screen.

This port follows C-Dogs SDL 2.5.0: the same campaigns (Ogre Rampage, Cyberdogs, Zombie and the rest), dogfight and deathmatch arenas, weapons, enemies and their AI, the menus, the briefing and equipment screens, the high scores, the original's 320x200 view with the DOS pixel aspect, its sounds and music.
Up to four local players on keyboards and gamepads, AI team-mates, and online games through this website's rooms, where every client runs the same lockstep simulation.
